meta.value_ref_syntax: every plotted value carries `src` (and `ci_src` for an interval) as file.json#a/b/c, resolved against 2-analysis/out/, with '/' separating keys because several keys contain a literal '.'
meta.font_note: PNGs are rendered in the vendored DM Sans (Analysis/assets/fonts/DMSans-*.ttf, which declares itself 'DM Sans 9pt') when it is present, otherwise matplotlib's DejaVu Sans. Weights 300/400/500/600 are vendored; no italic face exists, so nothing here asks for one. The house-style font conflict is open and is data-storyteller's to settle: match this face or record the change.
meta.palette_note: dataviz reference palette. Charts use the emphasis form — one accent plus the documented muted/base tokens — and a one-hue ordinal ramp where the marks are ordered. Roles, not hexes, carry meaning; the storyteller resolves light/dark from this block. Validator note: the accent-vs-muted pair clears CVD separation, the normal-vision floor and 3:1 contrast in both modes; the muted token is below the categorical chroma floor by design (it is de-emphasis, not identity) and every chart also carries direct labels or a legend.
barred_figures_kept_out_of_every_chart: the pooled publish-slot gap and the pooled reach figure (R3 B1)
